name: Bestow Speech
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 2/ranger 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target animal companion
Duration 10 minute/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Bestow speech may be cast only on your companion creature. Your companion creature gains the ability to speak any single language you know. The creature may converse with others that share this common language. The spell does not increase Intelligence, so the animal speaks from its point of view and knowledge.
